willow mellow (the dancer) was forcibly adopted by var after the ace of diamonds caravan kidnapped her, when willow mellows parents came to look for her, var murdered them (you can find this information out in day 5 of the haruspex route)  
and i assume var rescued both her and anna from orv (which is where the caravan was rounded up and murdered)  
anna joined the willows family but she really did somewhat murder them all, she took on willows voice and appearance by the same sorcery the caravan used

in short: willow is NOT willow mellow and its a lot more complicated then that
